items.statement: The validated gas-phase calculations support a thermodynamic and kinetic distinction among the three author-proposed tautomerization channels.
items.expected: P1 is favored relative to R by reaction energy, P2 and P3 are disfavored by reaction energy, and the kinetic barrier order is TS1 < TS3 < TS2 within the stated gas-phase model; the conclusion acknowledges model limitations.
